text.tspan: From the “Family Ramadan” program in Al-Morabbi
Your child's first fasts
Your child's first fasts
A gentle fasting ladder: love of fasting, not endurance
Training, not obligation:
Before puberty, fasting is training. The
aim is for the child to love fasting.
No fasting before seven:
Little ones share the atmosphere of
Ramadan without fasting.
Ages 4–6: waiting for the adhan:
He saves a pitted date until
maghrib to eat with the family; his meals stay complete.
Ages 7–9: hours, not days:
About three hours after suhoor at
first, building up gradually, rest days first.
One step at a time:
Move up only after two or three comfortable
days, and only if the child wants to.
Breaking the fast is not failure:
“Well done for trying; tomorrow
is a new day.” No blame, no comparing siblings.
Before Ramadan begins
Set each child's step on the fasting ladder according to age and health.
